review.identity: Compared with selected canonical original: Little Bird yellow watercolor body, dot eye, short orange beak and brown outline; Onagadori white feathered body, red crest/wattle, orange beak/feet and long layered ivory tail preserved.
review.style: All 27 complete cells reviewed in light/dark source composites plus individual neutral/wave_rest/seated calibration cells. Watercolor fill and contour preserve canonical family. No source pixels or alpha edited locally.
review.alpha: All 27 original RGBA exact cells pass alpha8 bounds and transparent-margin checks, including accepted background-edit sheets. Alpha128 used only for anatomy, not for source cleanup. Long Onagadori tail pixels are retained fully.
review.motion: All 27 key poses reviewed: blink, tap crouch/pop, cognitive/emotional reactions, wing clap/wave variants, celebration ready/air/land, seated transition/stretch/nap/look/stand and limited nod. Onagadori seated gaze turn is subtle. These are discrete key poses; actual episode timing, tail clearance and continuous animation need scene review.

pixel_processing: Lossless exact cell crops only. No repainting, alpha cleanup, contour edits or source rescaling.
